tanzania.notes: MAJOR DATA-INTEGRITY FINDING: 12 of 40 sites in this destination's file are not Tanzania dive sites at all and were removed from data/osm_clean/tanzania.json and divesites/tanzania/. Baixo Techantia/Magive Cobua/Nameguo/Varuni/Tambula (5 sites) are reefs in Cabo Delgado Province, Mozambique per Wikidata/GNS gazetteer coordinates, ~100km south of the Ruvuma River border. Playground Point/Kampagne Point/Kampagne South (3 sites) are on Lake Malawi in Malawi — confirmed via the raw OSM changeset's own German comment 'Tauchplatze Malawisee Nkhatabay' and Nominatim reverse-geocoding; a freshwater lake ~600km from Tanzania's coast, not even the ocean. Tawasal (1 wreck) is on Manda Island, Lamu County, Kenya per the OSM source object's own description. Captain Muddy/THGI Nungwi/Swahil Divers (3 sites) are dive-operator/tour-business names mistakenly scraped as dive sites, violating CLAUDE.md's no-commercial-business rule. Of the 28 real sites kept: Little Wall/Big Wall corrected from a hallucinated 'Pemba Island' narrative to their actual location (Mnemba Island); Barracuda Point relocated from northern Zanzibar/Nungwi to its real location off southeast Zanzibar (Paje/Jambiani); Stingray city corrected from the impossible 'southern stingray' (an Atlantic species) to the correct Blue Spotted Stingray; Moore Bank/Bedford Bank corrected from a Dar es Salaam framing to their actual Zanzibar Channel/Menai Bay location. The prior blanket 'perplexity' validation source (not a real citable domain) was removed destination-wide.
